name: Delegate
description: Hand work to another swarm agent — sparingly. Only for tunnel/SSH workplaces you cannot reach, an agent the user asked for, or genuinely parallel tasks. Do your own work otherwise.

function.name: delegate
function.description: Hand off to another session member. Use sparingly — only when (1) work is on a tunnel/SSH workplace owned by them and you cannot reach it, (2) the user asked for that agent or @mentioned them, or (3) you want a genuinely parallel swarm. For anything you can reach yourself — including local coding, ops, or research — do it yourself; a matching role is not a reason to delegate. After success the target runs immediately.

name.description: Target agent display name (alternative to agent_id).

reason.description: Full brief: goal, workplace id/name/host, paths, constraints, prior findings. Never a one-word reason.
